taxRules.bracketsDescription: Jordan uses a progressive tax system where different portions of your income are taxed at different rates. The rates apply to your annual taxable income after exemptions.
taxRules.nationalContribution: An additional 1% national contribution tax applies for individuals with income exceeding JOD 200,000 annually.
taxRules.exemptionsDescription: These amounts are deducted from your gross annual income before calculating the tax.

taxRules.residencyDescription: An individual is considered a tax resident if present in Jordan for 183 days or more in a calendar year. Both residents and non-residents are taxed only on income sourced in Jordan.
